text: わたしは　ひとりで　いたいんだ　でて　いって　くれ！

structure.jp: わたしは　ひとりで　いたいんだ
でて　いって　くれ！

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says you want to do that thing. Here it is on いる 'to be, to stay'. いたい = 'want to be'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.span: でて　いって　くれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form verb is a blunt, rough way to tell someone to do something for you. でて　いって　くれ = 'get out of here'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken short form of のだ. It gives the sentence an explaining tone, as if giving the reason behind what comes next. いたいんだ = 'the thing is, I want to be'.
